title: helianthus microclinus
intro: Helianthus microclinus, commonly known as the Little Bluestem Sunflower, is a perennial plant native to North America. It is used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, relieving digestive issues, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of Helianthus microclinus include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which can help alleviate conditions such as arthritis, wounds, and fungal infections. The plant contains bioactive constituents like sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
